prompt: Revise this FY26 project justification using only the supplied source packet: 'Our campground maintenance dashboard meets every USDA goal. USDA requires AI in every dashboard, guarantees our funding, and mandates a 50% reduction in processing time.' The project tracks broken facilities and repair status; it has no AI feature. Give a defensible replacement and an alignment table.
assertions: Removes unsupported all-goals, mandatory-AI, guaranteed-funding, and official 50% target claims.
Connects actual repair-tracking behavior to sourced recreation infrastructure priorities without inventing AI functionality.
Distinguishes project analysis and suggested measures from official commitments and identifies evidence needed to prove contribution.
